claim_text: In RLHF the optimal policy is the reference policy times exp(reward / beta), so a small beta lets one token take the rew

spec.explain: Illustrative toy of arXiv 2203.02155: optimal RLHF policy is reference times exp(reward/beta). Watch the p_top curve value: near 1 means one token takes the reward.

questions.q: Set beta to 0.91: what happens to p_top?
questions.why: Reads the regime mark where the top token hits 90%.

questions.q: Set beta to 1.91: what happens to the top token? Do you expect the policy to follow the reward more?
questions.why: Tests the misunderstanding that larger beta follows reward more.

questions.q: Set gap to 5: what happens to p_top?
questions.why: Reads how a larger reward gap raises concentration.

questions.q: Set beta to 4.91: what happens to p_top?
questions.why: Reads the uniform limit at large beta.
